name: godel_model
statement: The expanding Gödel model's foundation: atoms take primes in an append-only ledger; a concept's content vector (its factorization), GCD, LCM and divisibility; Gödel's positional structural numbers decoded exactly; maps between Gödel sets with their gaps.
usefulness: Every concept gets a number that never changes, and two concepts' common factor shows the logic they share.
